chunks.title: Asian Development Bank (ADB) (ADB) COP31 Role & Commitments
chunks.text: Asian Development Bank (ADB) is a Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) headquartered in Philippines (Multilateral). At UNFCCC COP31 in Antalya (November 9-20, 2026), its verified role is: Signed $1.19B+ COP31 Türkiye deals (resilient hospitals & VakıfBank SME line); joined TIDIP; MDB Adaptation Partnership; coal phase-out. Verified COP31 2026 climate finance commitment: €620M ($687M) disaster-resilient hospitals + $500M via VakıfBank for SMEs & women entrepreneurs (total $3.1B Türkiye support). Source verification: https://www.trtworld.com/article/08c7af154347.

chunks.title: ADB Financing Instruments & Ticket Bounds
chunks.text: Asian Development Bank (ADB) provides the following climate financing instruments: Sovereign Loan, Non-Sovereign Debt, Equity, Guarantee, Blended Concessional Finance, Technical Assistance Grant. Typical transaction ticket range is USD 10,000,000 to USD 500,000,000. Eligible applicant profiles include: Sovereign/Government, Large Corporate, Financial Intermediary, Project SPV, Municipality.

chunks.title: ADB Priority Climate Sectors & Regional Mandate
chunks.text: Priority climate sectors funded by Asian Development Bank (ADB): Climate Adaptation & Resilience, Renewable Energy, Industrial Decarbonization, SME Green Transition, Resilient Infrastructure & Health, Energy Transition. Target geographic focus includes: Asia, Asia-Pacific, Central Asia, Türkiye. Projects outside primary regions or ticket bounds may require syndicated or on-lending structures.

chunks.title: ADB Mandatory Form & Underwriting Requirements
chunks.text: Mandatory requirements to complete ADB's application form: ADB Paris Alignment screening (BB1 & BB2); ADB Safeguard Policy Statement (Environment, Involuntary Resettlement, Indigenous Peoples); Member country eligibility & development impact indicators; Financial & Integrity Due Diligence. Explicit exclusion rules: Coal mining and coal-fired power generation; Upstream oil & gas exploration. Official application portal: https://www.adb.org/work-with-us/private-sector-financing.

chunks.title: ADB Form Template: Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note
chunks.text: Asian Development Bank (ADB) uses the 'Multilateral Development Bank (MDB) Climate Project Concept Note' workflow governed by Joint MDB Paris Alignment Methodology (BB1 Mitigation / BB2 Adaptation) & Environmental/Social Framework. Typical review timeline is 6–16 weeks (Concept Clearance -> Appraisal -> Board Approval). Form sections required: 1. Identification, 2. Strategic Alignment, 3. Financial Structuring, 4. Climate & Technical Rationale, 5. Safeguards & Governance, 6. Execution & Risks, 7. Executive Summary.
